witness-to-heresy-build.name: Witness to Heresy farm
witness-to-heresy-build.summary: There are a few very easy ways to hold the Obsession's aura long enough to finish the full 300 seconds.
steps: Pick whichever option below is easiest for the group.
Keep the Obsession's aura visible until the achievement reaches 300 seconds.

variants.name: Mettle of Man — easiest organized option
variants.text: Have the Survivors bring Mettle of Man so whoever becomes the Obsession can use it. Trigger Mettle of Man with 3 Protection Hits, heal the Obsession back to full health, then keep them more than 16 metres from the Killer. Their aura stays revealed while the condition holds, so you can basically wait out the 300 seconds.
perks: Mettle of Man on the Survivors
steps: Get 3 Protection Hits on the Obsession to activate Mettle of Man.
Heal the Obsession back to full health.
Move the Obsession more than 16 metres away from the Killer.
Do not down the Obsession; just keep the aura visible until 300 seconds is finished.

variants.name: Scratched Mirror Shape
variants.text: Play The Shape with Scratched Mirror. Keep the Obsession within 32 metres and hold Stalk so their aura stays visible. Since Witness to Heresy itself is not restricted to The Judgment, this can finish the achievement without using the Judgment perk build.
steps: Find the Obsession.
Keep them within 32 metres of The Shape.
Hold Stalk to continuously reveal their aura.
Keep going until the achievement reaches 300 seconds.

variants.name: The Judgment perk build
variants.text: The original method still works if you want to do it while playing The Judgment: Celestial Witness, Lethal Pursuer, Friends 'Til the End and Nemesis. It is more active and slower than simply holding a continuous aura read, but it does not need Scratched Mirror.

notes: Mettle of Man also makes the Obsession more likely to start on one of the Survivors using it.

Mettle of Man currently activates after the third Protection Hit. After healing back to full, the Survivor's aura is revealed to the Killer while they are farther than 12/14/16 metres away depending on perk tier.

dream-demon-shack-loop.name: Dream Demon shack loop
dream-demon-shack-loop.summary: Use the shack gen and fake-pallet wake/sleep loop to keep pulling Survivors back into the Dream World.
steps: Go to the shack Generator and set the four Survivors up around it.
The Survivor closest to the pallet can stay seated while the others move toward them to get pulled into the Dream World.
Once Survivors are out of the Dream World, The Nightmare keeps spawning fake pallets and triggering/exploding them so the loop can start again.
Repeat until the achievement is done.
notes: A video walkthrough can be added later. The current loop is faster and more optimised than older showcase videos.

trapper-two-trap-loop.name: Trapper two-trap loop
trapper-two-trap-loop.summary: One Survivor and two traps are enough to repeatedly get direct trap pickups.
steps: Set two Bear Traps.
The Survivor walks into one trap.
Pick them directly out of the trap.
While carrying them, walk into the second open trap so the Survivor gets dropped/free.
Reset and repeat, always keeping one open trap ready for yourself.

variants.name: Iridescent Stone + Trapper Sack
variants.text: You can gamble on traps reopening themselves. Put 3-4 traps on the floor so there is a better chance one is ready for the next loop.

variants.name: Cutting Out add-on
variants.text: If a Survivor still needs Cutting Out, occasionally skip the self-trap drop and let them wiggle free instead.

notes: Do not hit the trapped Survivor; the achievement progress comes from grabbing them directly out of the trap.

not-today-facecamp.name: Not Today facecamp loop
not-today-facecamp.summary: Use the anti-camp self-unhook instead of relying on luck.
steps: Have the Killer facecamp the hooked Survivor.
Let the anti-camp meter fill.
Self-unhook when available.
Repeat over more matches until finished.
notes: Confirmed method. Shoulder the Burden does not help the actual self-unhook count.

skilled-huntress-boon-range.name: Skilled Huntress boon-range farm
skilled-huntress-boon-range.summary: Use a 24m boon radius as an easy in-game distance marker for the hatchet downs.
steps: Set up the boon.
Survivors stand around the outside edge of the boon radius.
Huntress stands beside a locker at the correct distance and downs them with hatchets.
Heal everyone and repeat.

variants.name: Close Shave variant
variants.text: Before landing the real hatchet, throw close misses around the Survivor. If the game counts them as dodged projectiles, the Survivor can work on Close Shave at the same time.

notes: Standing beside a locker keeps hatchet refills quick.

fleet-of-foot-loop.name: Fleet of Foot speed loop
fleet-of-foot-loop.summary: Babysitter is the clean recommendation; Dark Theory also works but can track inconsistently.
steps: With Babysitter, rotate safe unhooks to give the Haste effect.
With Dark Theory, have Survivors walk out of the boon and only re-enter once the previous speed boost is fully gone.
Repeat until the achievement finishes.
notes: Dark Theory works, but you may end up needing far more activations than the listed 50. Shoulder the Burden can give the achievement hunter another useful unhook.

path-to-salvation-loop.name: Path to Salvation gen/heal loop
path-to-salvation-loop.summary: Pre-heal, pop the Generator, then finish the heal immediately.
steps: Take a hit.
Self-Care or have someone heal you to around 90% or more.
Finish a Generator.
Have one or two Survivors immediately finish your heal.
Repeat on the next Generator.
notes: This can be worked into a normal organised farm without much extra time.

bless-you-loop.name: Bless You pallet / Hex loop
bless-you-loop.summary: Force the same remaining Totem to become Hex: Two Can Play over and over, bless it, snuff it and reset the pallet.
steps: Cleanse every Totem except one dull Totem next to a pallet.
Stun the Killer once.
The Bless You player starts blessing the remaining Totem.
At about 80% blessing progress, stun the Killer again so Two Can Play activates with almost no wasted time.
Finish the blessing so it counts as blessing a Hex.
The Killer snuffs the boon.
Reset the pallet with Any Means Necessary.
Repeat.

variants.name: Hero of Wallachia stack
variants.text: If the achievement hunter holds the right item while doing the pallet stuns, this loop can also be used for Hero of Wallachia.

notes: The snuff step matters. If the Killer does not snuff the boon, the loop does not reset cleanly.

survivor-adept-farm.name: Survivor Adept farm
survivor-adept-farm.summary: Use the required three unique perks, then either finish the game normally or make the Adept player the hatch escape.
steps: The Adept player brings only that Survivor's three Unique Perks.
Either complete all Generators and let them escape, or have the Killer 3K and give that Survivor hatch.
notes: Tell the group first because the Adept player cannot use the usual farming loadout.

killer-adept-farm.name: Killer Adept farm
killer-adept-farm.summary: Use only the Killer's three unique perks and finish with a fast 4K.
steps: Bring only that Killer's three Unique Perks.
Do any other power achievement you want first if it does not require extra Killer perks.
For a fast finish, have all four Survivors die in basement.
notes: Add-ons are fine; the Adept restriction is the Killer perk loadout.

carry-farm.name: Carry achievement farm
carry-farm.summary: Keep one Survivor carried while the rest rotate hits and fast heals around the Killer.
survivorPerks: Mettle of Man on Survivors taking repeated Protection Hits
Boon: Circle of Healing on one Survivor
Botany Knowledge / other healing speed perks spread around the team
steps: Down Survivor A and pick them up.
Survivors B, C and D rotate taking protection hits while A is carried.
Everyone should have Reactive Healing so nearby hits help the whole reset loop.
Use Circle of Healing, Botany Knowledge and one Leader to heal everyone back up quickly.
For Multi-tasker, let an already injured Survivor get downed while A is still being carried.
When Cutting Out is needed, stop the hit loop and let A wiggle free.
Reset and repeat.
notes: Only one Survivor needs Leader. Agitation is more useful here than Mad Grit because everyone is cooperating and it helps reposition the carry faster.

Mettle of Man is very useful for the protection-hit rotation: after the third Protection Hit it shields the next hit that would put that Survivor into the Dying State, letting the loop squeeze in another hit before a reset.

hag-trap-farm.name: Hag two-trap teleport farm
hag-trap-farm.summary: Rotate between two Phantasm Traps so one Survivor can trigger them almost nonstop.
steps: Place Trap A and Trap B close enough to rotate between.
The Survivor triggers A and then moves into B.
Teleport to A and replace it.
Teleport to B and replace it.
The Survivor loops back into A and keeps alternating.
Repeat until Triggered is done.
notes: For Even Punishment, first have each of the four Survivors trigger a trap and take one hit after the teleport. Then one Survivor can stay for the long Triggered grind.

doctor-shock-farm.name: Doctor shock farm
doctor-shock-farm.summary: Group all four Survivors and hit as many of them as possible with every Shock Therapy.
killerAddons: Discipline add-ons (recommended for the faster Shock Therapy detonation)
steps: Have all four Survivors stand tightly grouped.
Shock the whole group until everybody reaches Madness Tier III for Mad House.
Keep them grouped and continue hitting as many Survivors as possible per Shock Therapy.
Have Survivors Snap Out of It when needed and keep repeating.
notes: The point is to make every Shock Therapy hit multiple people instead of grinding 500 one at a time.

wraith-jump-scare-farm.name: Wraith Surprise Attack farm
wraith-jump-scare-farm.summary: Alternate uncloaking hits between Survivors while the team resets the damage quickly.
steps: Set up a healing area.
Wraith cloaks, uncloaks directly beside a Survivor and lands the Surprise Attack.
The team heals that Survivor while Wraith recloaks.
Rotate targets and repeat.
notes: Uncloaking-speed add-ons can make the loop less boring.

ghostface-mark-farm.name: Ghost Face Mark farm
ghostface-mark-farm.summary: Mark, down, reset the Survivor, then repeat without anyone revealing Ghost Face.
steps: Pick one Survivor with a clean sightline.
Ghost Face stalks them until Marked.
Down them.
The other Survivors pick/heal them back up.
Rotate targets and repeat.
notes: Nobody should reveal Ghost Face on purpose during the loop.

triage-station.name: Triage healing station
triage-station.summary: The achievement hunter stays put while the injured Survivor travels back to them for each heal.
steps: Set up a healing station.
The achievement hunter stays in that small area.
A partner goes more than 16m away and gets hit.
The injured partner comes back to the achievement hunter.
Heal them without the achievement hunter travelling far.
Repeat.
notes: The injured person should come to the healer, not the other way around.

healing-achievement-farm.name: Healing achievement farm
healing-achievement-farm.summary: Keep multiple Survivors injured and repeatedly heal the Obsession while Reactive Healing speeds up every reset.
steps: Use Nemesis to make the achievement target the Obsession with a pallet stun.
Keep at least three Survivors injured/downed/hooked for Resurgence progress.
Repeatedly injure and heal the Obsession for Healthy Obsession and Medic.
For Second Act, down the achievement hunter and have someone recover them from Dying State before resetting.
notes: Everyone having Reactive Healing is the base of the healing build. Only one Survivor needs Leader.

aura-farm.name: Killer aura farm
aura-farm.summary: Use Still Sight with a cooperating Killer for easy continuous aura reading.
steps: Have the Killer stand inside Still Sight range.
Stand still until the Killer aura is revealed.
For Honour the Bloodline, simply keep the reveal going long enough.
For Lifting the Fog, move briefly to turn Still Sight off, stand still again, and repeat the reveal cycle.

variants.name: Lifting the Fog reactivation count
variants.text: Check that every Still Sight reactivation counts as a new aura reveal. If not, switch to Fogwise + Deadline and farm Great Skill Checks while injured.

working-overtime-farm.name: Working Overtime slow-gen farm
working-overtime-farm.summary: This is one of the rare farms where you deliberately keep Generators alive instead of finishing quickly.
steps: Designate one Survivor as the achievement hunter.
Do not give them repair-speed perks or a toolbox.
Let them spend most of the match repairing while the Killer repeatedly damages different Generators.
Once they have enough repair time, finish the match normally.
notes: Normal organised farming can be too fast for this one, so the group has to deliberately slow the Generator phase down.

generalist-farm.name: Generalist / Power Moves farm
generalist-farm.summary: Have each Survivor repair their own equivalent of one Generator and escape; all four players can progress together.
steps: Choose the achievement loadout: 0 perks for Power Moves, 2 universal perks for Expert Generalist, or 3 universal perks for Skilled Generalist.
Put each Survivor on their own Generator so everyone gets enough personal repair progress.
Finish the match and make sure everyone escapes.
Repeat for the required number of Trials.
notes: This is a good group project because all four Survivors can work on the same achievement at the same time.

disturbed-ward-stack.name: Disturbed Ward achievement stack
disturbed-ward-stack.summary: A dedicated Disturbed Ward match can potentially stack several annoying escape achievements.
steps: Load into Disturbed Ward.
Achievement hunter pallet-stuns the Killer so Nemesis makes them the Obsession.
The Killer never hits that Survivor.
Make the special Disturbed Ward Generator the final Generator.
The other three Survivors die and fully reach the dead state.
Achievement hunter finishes the last Generator, opens the Exit Gate and leaves last.

variants.name: Four-achievement stack
variants.text: This setup is intended to combine Haemophobia + Shock Therapy + Item of Obsession + Left For Dead in one match. If any one of them tracks differently on your platform, split it off instead.

notes: The three other Survivors need to be fully dead before the last Survivor completes the final Generator for Left For Dead.

engineer-farm.name: Engineer damaged-gen rotation
engineer-farm.summary: Get one Engineer count from each Generator in the match instead of waiting for random kicks.
steps: Touch a Generator so it has progress.
Killer damages it.
Achievement hunter repairs that damaged Generator.
Move to the next Generator and repeat once per Generator.
Finish the match normally after the useful Generators have been counted.

injured-gen-farm.name: Injured Generator farm
injured-gen-farm.summary: Stay injured while working Generators, farm Great Skill Checks, then use the Path to Salvation heal timing.
steps: Get injured early and stay injured for most of the Trial.
Repair Generators while injured and hit Great Skill Checks for Under Pressure.
Before a Generator finishes, pre-heal to around 90% if you are doing Path to Salvation.
Finish the Generator, then immediately finish the heal.
Get injured again and continue until the match is done.
Escape after spending more than half the Trial injured for Sorted.
notes: The Path to Salvation part is already used; the bigger stack is where you can save extra matches.

controlled-chase-farm.name: Controlled chase farm
controlled-chase-farm.summary: Use shack or another clean pallet/window area to farm a whole block of chase achievements.
steps: Start one long controlled Chase.
Keep it going for at least 90 seconds.
Killer deliberately misses attacks before vaults.
Survivor repeats Pallet and Window vaults while the Chase is active.
Take a hit and Rushed Vault within 3 seconds when working on Desperate Escape.
Pallet stun the Killer, then break Chase for Insult and Injury / With Scars to Show.
Reset useful Pallets with Any Means Necessary.
For Hiding Seeker, end selected Chases by entering a Locker and having the Killer leave.

variants.name: Close Shave counting
variants.text: Use close Basic Attack misses first. Projectile misses can also be tried, but check how generously they register.

hatch-crawl-stack.name: Hatch crawl stack
hatch-crawl-stack.summary: Down the last Survivor beside an open Hatch and have them crawl through it.
steps: Let the other three Survivors leave or die.
Find/open the Hatch for the final Survivor.
Killer downs that Survivor right beside it.
Survivor crawls through the Hatch while in Dying State.

variants.name: Triple count
variants.text: The requirements overlap enough that this may award Outrun Evil, Backdoor Escape and Agonizing Escape together. Check platform tracking before calling it guaranteed.

pallet-rescue-loop.name: Pallet rescue loop
pallet-rescue-loop.summary: Keep resetting the same pallet and repeat pallet saves.
steps: Down a Survivor beside a pallet.
Killer picks them up under the pallet.
Achievement hunter stuns the Killer for the save.
Reset the pallet with Any Means Necessary.
Repeat.

hook-unhook-farm.name: Hook / unhook achievement farm
hook-unhook-farm.summary: Rotate hooks, safe unhooks and protection hits so several hook achievements move together.
survivorPerks: No Mither / another Broken setup for Bloodied Hands
Reactive Healing on the rest of the team
Mettle of Man for Survivors farming repeated Protection Hits
steps: Achievement hunter stays Broken when working on Bloodied Hands.
Safely unhook Survivors.
Babysitter gives the Haste for Fleet of Foot.
The freshly unhooked Survivor can intentionally take a hit while Endurance is active for One More Step.
Another Survivor takes protection hits around the unhooked player for Taking One For The Team.
Reset and rotate hooks.
notes: Shoulder the Burden can help extend the rotation but is not required for the achievements themselves.

Mettle of Man is useful on whoever is taking the protection hits. After the third Protection Hit it can absorb the next hit that would normally down them, which gives the group another protection-hit opportunity before resetting.

endgame-cleanup.name: Endgame achievement cleanup
endgame-cleanup.summary: Use the last couple minutes after farming instead of immediately leaving.
steps: Finish the normal farm and power the Exit Gates.
Open a Gate when you are ready to start Endgame Collapse.
Do post-Generator heals for Ever Vigilant.
Take protection hits during Endgame Collapse for Final Days.
Hook and rescue someone after the Gates are powered for No One Left Behind.
Achievement hunters for Break For It leave while Broken.
Rotate who opens Gates for Escaping the Nightmare.

judgment-farm.name: Judgment achievement round
judgment-farm.summary: One organised Judgment session can cover most of the new power interactions.
steps: Do the Witness to Heresy aura build if the Killer still needs it.
Survivors deliberately taunt The Judgment to gain Heresy.
Down and Exile Heretic Survivors for the Exile-related progress.
Let the Survivor escape Exile without getting hit by Seeds of Punishment for Above Judgment.
Line Survivors up at 16m+ for Under my Dominion Divine Light hits.
notes: Taunting can be done with repeated crouches/gestures close to The Judgment, which makes Heresy easy to coordinate.

grab-farm.name: Grab achievement match
grab-farm.summary: Use one dedicated match to rotate through Generator, Totem, vault and Locker grabs.
steps: Do Generator grabs for Silent Approach.
Do Totem grabs for Quick Draw.
Do vault grabs for Taste the Darkness.
Do Locker grabs for From the Deep.
Reset the interaction and repeat each one as needed.
notes: This is mainly useful because coordinated Survivors can keep presenting the exact grab interaction you need.

basement-healing-farm.name: Basement healing farm
basement-healing-farm.summary: Keep all the hit/heal resets inside basement so every heal is useful progress.
survivorPerks: Boon: Circle of Healing if placement allows
steps: Set up the Survivors in basement.
Killer repeatedly injures them there.
Heal the required Health States without leaving basement.
Repeat.
notes: Can be combined with general healing progress such as Medic if those players still need it.
